# selector text quote

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/selectorTextQuote>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A verbatim text quote from the cited work, expressed as a literal within a selector.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) from [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the verbatim passage a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) anchors on — the durable, re-locatable form of a pinpoint that survives re-pagination of the cited work.

### Avoid when

- Avoid paraphrasing here (the quote must be verbatim) and avoid using it as the offset (that is [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md)); language-tag the literal where the source language is known.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) on a [`gmeow:Selector`](../classes/gmeow-Selector.md) to the verbatim string, language-tagged; pair with [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md) or [`gmeow:selectorPage`](gmeow-selectorPage.md) to anchor it precisely.

### Examples

- ex:span [`gmeow:selectorTextQuote`](gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md) "born the third day of March"@en.
